Yellow and red variety text overlays appear. (3) The woman holds a red envelope in front of a colorful anime poster inside a store. Gold confetti graphics fall across the screen. (4) The camera shows a night street view from a car, passing city lights and storefronts. (5) Back to the woman in the car, she is now smiling and looking directly at the camera.
